HOOLHEYAKMOD-VARIABLE_CHOICE_CARD.title: Variable {Symbol}
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STRIKE_HOOLHEYAK.title: Strike
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DEFEND_HOOLHEYAK.title: Defend
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FEATHER_STRIKE.title: Feather Strike
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LINGER.title: Linger
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LINGER.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Look at the top {Linger-Look:diff()} cards of your draw pile.
Choose up to {Linger-Look:diff()} cards. [gold]Variable[/gold]:
Discard them;
Put them on the bottom of your draw pile.
Draw {Linger-Draw:diff()} cards.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LINGER.variable.1: Put them on the bottom of your draw pile.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CONTROL_GROUP.title: Control Group
HOOLHEYAKMOD-RESEARCH.title: Research
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LAMINAR_FLOW.title: Laminar Flow
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DISTILLED_TIME.title: Distilled Time
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DISTILLED_TIME.description:
Immediately obtain a random Attack Potion, Skill Potion, or Power Potion.
At the start of your turn, gain 3 [gold]Doom[/gold] and obtain another.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COMPOSE.title: Compose
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COMPOSE.variable.0: Reduce the cost of a card in your hand by 3.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COMPOSE.variable.1: Reduce the cost of all cards in your hand by 1.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COMPOSE.selectionScreenProm: Choose a card in your hand to reduce its cost.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-REFUTATION.title: Refutation
HOOLHEYAKMOD-REFUTATION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Reduce a random buff on the target by 1. If fewer stacks make it stronger, increase it by 1 instead. Cannot affect phase transitions or revival mechanics.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-HEADWIND.title: Headwind
HOOLHEYAKMOD-HEADWIND.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply 1 [gold]Lift[/gold] to a random enemy.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WIND_SHEAR.title: Wind Shear
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TURBULENCE.title: Turbulence
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TURBULENCE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Once per turn, for every 2 Turbulence cards played this combat, add {Turbulence-Magic:diff()} Turbulence to your hand.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TAIL_STING.title: Tail Sting
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CONVECTION.title: Convection
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CONVECTION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Costs 1 less for each Attack you play this turn.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ARCHIVE.title: Archive
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ARCHIVE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Fatal[/gold]: After combat, choose an additional card. [gold]Variable[/gold]:
A card of a random color;
A Colorless card.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ARCHIVE.variable.0: After combat, choose an additional card of a random color.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ARCHIVE.variable.1: After combat, choose an additional Colorless card.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COERCION.title: Coercion
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COERCION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target has [gold]Levitation[/gold], make it fall. Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the falling damage and {IfUpgraded:show:{energyPrefix:energyIcons(2)}|{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}}.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SURVEYING.title: Surveying
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SURVEYING.variable.1: Put them on the bottom of your draw pile.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SURVEYING.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Look at the top {Surveying-Magic:diff()} cards of your draw pile. Choose up to {Surveying-Magic:diff()} cards. [gold]Variable[/gold]:
Discard them;
Put them on the bottom of your draw pile.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BRUSHSTROKE.title: Brushstroke
HOOLHEYAKMOD-MAD_WORDS.title: Well-Read Ravings
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CROSS_EXPERIMENT.title: Crossover Experiment
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CROSS_EXPERIMENT.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
When played, this card permanently gains [gold]Variable[/gold]:
+{Cross-Growth:diff()} damage;
+{Cross-Growth:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-REVISION.title: Revision
HOOLHEYAKMOD-REVISION.select_message: Choose a card in your hand to exhaust.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-REVISION.description: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card in your hand. Obtain a random card of the same type.{IfUpgraded:show: It costs 0 this turn.|}
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FORESHADOWING.title: Foreshadowing
HOOLHEYAKMOD-OBSERVATION.title: Observation
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FOOTNOTE.title: Footnote
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TAMPER.title: Tamper
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PARAMETER_CORRECTION.title: Parameter Correction
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PARAMETER_CORRECTION.descri:
At the end of your turn, if this card is in your hand, you may give up to {ParameterCorrection-Magic:diff()} cards in your hand [gold]Retain[/gold] this turn.
Whenever this effect triggers, gain 1 [gold]Meander[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PARAMETER_CORRECTION.select: Choose up to {ParameterCorrection-Magic} other cards in your hand to give [gold]Retain[/gold] this turn.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LITERATURE_RETRIEVAL.title: Literature Retrieval
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LITERATURE_RETRIEVAL.descri: Choose 1 of 3 random Attacks, Skills, or Powers of random colors to add to your hand{IfUpgraded:show:. It costs 0 this turn.|.}
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LITERATURE_RETRIEVAL.select: Choose a card to add to your hand.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-MASS_OFFSET.title: Mass Offset
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FLY_UP.title: Fly Up!
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FLY_UP.description:
Gain {FlyUp-Analysis:diff()} [gold]Analysis[/gold].
Trigger {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} times. [gold]Variable[/gold]:
[gold]Erudition[/gold];
[gold]Meander[/gold].
These triggers use your [gold]Analysis[/gold] at the start of this effect.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COLD_EYE.title: Cold Eye
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COLD_EYE.description:
Gain {ColdEye-Magic:diff()} [gold]Analysis[/gold].
Apply 2 [gold]Weak[/gold] and 2 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to yourself and ALL enemies.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-INHERITED_END.title: Inherited End
HOOLHEYAKMOD-INHERITED_END.description: This turn, whenever you alternate between playing Attacks and Skills, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and draw 1 card.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-POWERED_EXOSKELETON.title: Powered Exoskeleton
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STARGAZING.title: Stargazing
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STARGAZING.description:
Look at the top {Stargazing-Magic:diff()} cards of your draw pile.
Choose up to {Stargazing-Magic:diff()} cards. [gold]Variable[/gold]:
Discard them;
Put them on the bottom of your draw pile.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STARGAZING.variable.1: Put them on the bottom of your draw pile.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-RECURSIVE_EXPERIMENT.title: Recursive Experiment
HOOLHEYAKMOD-RECURSIVE_EXPERIMENT.variab: Spend 1 Energy. Play a random card from your deck and permanently remove it from your deck. After combat, gain an additional card reward of the same type. Then start another round of the experiment.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-REDUNDANT_EXPERIMENT.title: Redundant Experiment
HOOLHEYAKMOD-REDUNDANT_EXPERIMENT.variab: Shuffle, then put them on top of your draw pile.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-REDUNDANT_EXPERIMENT.select: Choose up to {Redundant-Count} cards in your hand.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BYGONE_WINGS.title: Bygone Wings
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BYGONE_WINGS.description: Whenever you play a card of another color, reduce the cost of a random card in your hand by 1 until it is next played or this turn ends.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-INHERITED_MEMORIES.title: Inherited Memories
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FORBIDDEN_KNOWLEDGE.title: Forbidden Knowledge
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FORBIDDEN_KNOWLEDGE.variabl: Whenever you trigger [gold]Erudition[/gold], draw 1 additional card.
Whenever you trigger [gold]Meander[/gold], deal 5 damage to ALL enemies.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CYCLONE.title: Cyclone
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WINGBLADE.title: Wingblade
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WINGBLADE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If this card triggers [gold]Erudition[/gold], [gold]Replay[/gold] 1.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ENTROPY_INCREASE.title: Entropy Increase
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ENTROPY_INCREASE.descriptio: At the start of your turn, add a random Power of a random color to your hand.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ANCIENT_COVENANT.title: Ancient Covenant
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WARDROBE.title: K'uk'ulkan's Wardrobe
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WARDROBE.description: Whenever you play a card of another color, add a random card of your color to your hand and give it [gold]Exhaust[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show:. It costs 0 this combat|}.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-OMNISCIENT_HORIZON.title: Omniscient Horizon
HOOLHEYAKMOD-OMNISCIENT_HORIZON.descript: Whenever an enemy gains [gold]Levitation[/gold], draw 2 cards and gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(2)}.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SERPENT_BLOODLINE.title: K'uk'ulkan Bloodline
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SERPENT_BLOODLINE.descripti:
Gain [gold]Ritual[/gold] equal to your [gold]Analysis[/gold]. Then, whenever you gain [gold]Analysis[/gold], gain that much [gold]Ritual[/gold].
At the start of each turn, lose {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-VOYAGE_OF_LONE_TRAIL.title: Lone Trail's Radiance
HOOLHEYAKMOD-VOYAGE_OF_LONE_TRAIL.descri: At the end of your turn, if you dealt less than 6 attack damage this turn, trigger [gold]Meander[/gold] and [gold]Erudition[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CORRECTED_VARIABLE.title: Corrected Variable
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CORRECTED_VARIABLE.descript:
Whenever you draw a Status, gain {Corrected-Magic:diff()} [gold]Erudition[/gold].
Whenever you draw a Curse, gain {Corrected-Magic:diff()} [gold]Meander[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BYPRODUCT.title: Byproduct
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BYPRODUCT.description: Whenever you activate a [gold]Variable[/gold], obtain 1 random {IfUpgraded:show:Upgraded |}card.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-KUKULKAN_LEGACY.title: K'uk'ulkan's Legacy
HOOLHEYAKMOD-KUKULKAN_LEGACY.description: Increase the stacks needed to trigger [gold]Erudition[/gold] and [gold]Meander[/gold] by {Kukulkan-Magic:diff()}. Double their damage and [gold]Lift[/gold] applied.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TWIN_EXPERIMENT.title: Twin Experiment
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TWIN_EXPERIMENT.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice to two random enemies.
If two different enemies are hit, deal an additional {Damage:diff()} damage twice. [gold]Variable[/gold]:
To the enemy with more HP remaining;
To the enemy with less HP remaining.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TWIN_EXPERIMENT.variable.0: Deal the additional damage to the enemy with more HP remaining.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TWIN_EXPERIMENT.variable.1: Deal the additional damage to the enemy with less HP remaining.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-KNOCK_IN_EXPERIMENT.title: Knock-In Experiment
HOOLHEYAKMOD-KNOCK_IN_EXPERIMENT.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Variable[/gold]:
Spend {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} to heal 3 HP;
Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CONJUNCTION_CARD.title: Conjunction
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CONJUNCTION_CARD.descriptio:
[gold]Neutral[/gold]
[gold]Unplayable[/gold].
When drawn, automatically trigger and replace your current Aspect with [gold]Conjunction[/gold]: Damage you deal and damage enemies deal to you are increased by 50%.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-QUINCUNX_CARD.title: Quincunx
HOOLHEYAKMOD-QUINCUNX_CARD.description:
[gold]Neutral[/gold]
[gold]Unplayable[/gold].
When drawn, automatically trigger and replace your current Aspect with [gold]Quincunx[/gold]: Your Skills grant [gold]Erudition[/gold] and your Attacks grant [gold]Meander[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SEXTILE_CARD.title: Sextile
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SEXTILE_CARD.description:
[gold]Benefic[/gold]
[gold]Unplayable[/gold].
When drawn, automatically trigger and replace your current Aspect with [gold]Sextile[/gold]: [gold]Erudition[/gold] and [gold]Meander[/gold] require 2 fewer stacks to trigger, but you can no longer apply [gold]Lift[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TRINE_CARD.title: Trine
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TRINE_CARD.description:
[gold]Benefic[/gold]
[gold]Unplayable[/gold].
When drawn, automatically trigger and replace your current Aspect with [gold]Trine[/gold]: On entering this Aspect and at the start of your turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and draw 2 cards. Your Attacks have [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SQUARE_CARD.title: Square
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SQUARE_CARD.description:
[gold]Malefic[/gold]
[gold]Unplayable[/gold].
When drawn, automatically trigger and replace your current Aspect with [gold]Square[/gold]: Whenever you play a card, lose 1 HP and apply 1 [gold]Lift[/gold] to ALL enemies.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-OPPOSITION_CARD.title: Opposition
HOOLHEYAKMOD-OPPOSITION_CARD.description:
[gold]Malefic[/gold]
[gold]Unplayable[/gold].
When drawn, automatically trigger and replace your current Aspect with [gold]Opposition[/gold]: You cannot gain [gold]Block[/gold]. ALL enemies receive twice as much [gold]Lift[/gold] (multiplies independently with [gold]Weightless[/gold]).
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TRANSIT.title: Transit
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SHOCKWAVE.title: Shockwave
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SHOCKWAVE.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {Shockwave-Magic:diff()} [gold]Weightless[/gold] to ALL enemies.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SEPARATION.title: Separation
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SEPARATION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Reduce the target's Max HP by the same amount.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CHIMERA_EXPERIMENT.title: Chimera Experiment
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CHIMERA_EXPERIMENT.variable: Play Attacks from the top of your draw pile.
Play Skills from the top of your draw pile.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CONTINGENCY_PLAN.title: Contingency Plan
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CONTINGENCY_PLAN.descriptio:
Gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
Whenever you trigger [gold]Meander[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show: or [gold]Erudition[/gold]|}, return this card from your discard pile to your hand.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DYNAMIC_PRESSURE.title: Dynamic Pressure
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BAROCLINIC_INSTABILITY.desc:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage,
apply {Baroclinic-Magic:diff()} [gold]Deconstruction[/gold],
and apply {Baroclinic-Lift:diff()} [gold]Lift[/gold] to ALL enemies.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DEEPTHINK.title: Deep Thought
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BORROWED_WEAPONS.title: Borrowed Weapons
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BORROWED_WEAPONS.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a random Attack of another color to your hand.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-AUGMENTATION_EXPERIMENT.des:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Variable[/gold]:
Gain {Augmentation-Analysis:diff()} [gold]Analysis[/gold];
Add a new Augmentation Experiment to your hand and gain {Augmentation-BonusAnalysis:diff()} [gold]Analysis[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-AUGMENTATION_EXPERIMENT.var: Add a new Augmentation Experiment to your hand and gain {Augmentation-BonusAnalysis:diff()} [gold]Analysis[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-APOPTOSIS_EXPERIMENT.title: Apoptosis Experiment
HOOLHEYAKMOD-APOPTOSIS_EXPERIMENT.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply to the target, [gold]Variable[/gold]:
{Apoptosis-Lift:diff()} [gold]Lift[/gold];
{Apoptosis-Deconstruction:diff()} [gold]Deconstruction[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CONTROL_EXPERIMENT.title: Controlled Experiment
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CONTROL_EXPERIMENT.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Variable[/gold]:
Add a random [gold]Aspect[/gold] to your draw pile and draw 2 cards;
Add a random [gold]Aspect[/gold] to your discard pile, then immediately shuffle.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CONTROL_EXPERIMENT.variable: Add a random [gold]Aspect[/gold] to your draw pile and draw 2 cards.
Add a random [gold]Aspect[/gold] to your discard pile, then immediately shuffle.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-MUTAGENESIS_EXPERIMENT.desc:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Variable[/gold]:
Trigger a random [gold]Aspect[/gold];
[gold]Spend[/gold] {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} to trigger a random [gold]Benefic Aspect[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TRANSITIONAL_FLOW.title: Transitional Flow
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WAKE.title: Wake
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WAKE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain {Wake-Magic:diff()} [gold]Analysis[/gold].
If the last card you played was a Skill, [gold]Replay[/gold] 1.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-UNIVERSAL_MAPPING.title: Universal Mapping
HOOLHEYAKMOD-UNIVERSAL_MAPPING.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Play {UniversalMapping-Count:diff()} random Rare Attacks of other colors. They are removed from this combat after being played.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DIVERGENCE.title: Divergence
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DIVERGENCE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Consume[/gold] all of the target's [gold]Lift[/gold]. For each stack [gold]consumed[/gold], gain {Divergence-Magic:diff()} additional [gold]Block[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CONVERGENCE.title: Convergence
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CONVERGENCE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Gain additional [gold]Block[/gold] equal to ALL enemies' total [gold]Gravity[/gold] (up to {Convergence-Cap:diff()}).
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CROSS_SEARCH.title: Cross-Reference
HOOLHEYAKMOD-RAPIDS.title: Rapids
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FACTORIAL_EXPERIMENT.title: Factorial Experiment
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FACTORIAL_EXPERIMENT.descri:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Variable[/gold]:
Trigger a random [gold]Variable[/gold] on (most) [gold]Variable[/gold] cards in your hand;
Add 3 random [gold]Variable[/gold] cards to your hand. They cost 0 this turn.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FACTORIAL_EXPERIMENT.variab: Trigger a random [gold]Variable[/gold] on each [gold]Variable[/gold] card in your hand that allows automatic activation.
Add {Factorial-Count:diff()} random [gold]Variable[/gold] cards to your hand. They cost 0 this turn.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-NECROTIC_STRIPPING.title: Necrotic Stripping
HOOLHEYAKMOD-NECROTIC_STRIPPING.descript:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {NecroticStripping-Hits:diff()} times.
[gold]Slough[/gold]: Remove ALL debuffs from yourself. For each type removed, trigger [gold]Erudition[/gold] once.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-INFILTRATIVE_NECROSIS.title: Infiltrative Necrosis
HOOLHEYAKMOD-INFILTRATIVE_NECROSIS.descr:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {InfiltrativeNecrosis-Hits:diff()} times.
Then gain 99 [gold]Dark Shackles[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COMORBIDITY_MODEL.title: Comorbidity Model
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COMORBIDITY_MODEL.descripti:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Slough[/gold]: Deal {ComorbidityModel-Bonus:diff()} additional damage for each different debuff you have.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-REBIRTH_REFLEX.title: Rebirth Reflex
HOOLHEYAKMOD-REBIRTH_REFLEX.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
The next Skill you play this turn gains Replay 1.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOLLOWBONE_SYNDROME.title: Hollowbone Syndrome
HOOLHEYAKMOD-HOLLOWBONE_SYNDROME.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply 2 [gold]Weightless[/gold] to the target.
[gold]Slough[/gold]: Apply 2 [gold]Lift[/gold] to the target.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PUTRID_OBLATION.title: Putrid Oblation
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PUTRID_OBLATION.variable.0: Lose all Block. You cannot gain Block this turn. Draw {PutridOblation-Draw:diff()} cards and gain {PutridOblation-Energy:diff()} Energy.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PUTRID_OBLATION.variable.1: You cannot draw cards this turn. Gain {Block:diff()} Block and {PutridOblation-Energy:diff()} Energy.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PUTRID_OBLATION.variable.2: You cannot gain Energy this turn. Gain {Block:diff()} Block and draw {PutridOblation-Draw:diff()} cards.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COMPENSATORY_HYPERPLASIA.de:
Draw {CompensatoryHyperplasia-Draw:diff()} cards. Exhaust 1 card in your hand.
[gold]Slough[/gold]: Then draw 1 additional card.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TWINNED_PATHOLOGIES.title: Twinned Pathologies
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TWINNED_PATHOLOGIES.descrip:
Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
[gold]Slough[/gold]: Choose a [gold]Variable[/gold] for a random debuff on yourself:
Reduce it by 1 and draw 1 card;
Increase it by 1 and gain 1 [gold]Analysis[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TWINNED_PATHOLOGIES.variabl: Reduce a random debuff on yourself by 1. Draw 1 card.
Increase a random debuff on yourself by 1. Gain 1 [gold]Analysis[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PARASITIC_REGROWTH.title: Parasitic Regrowth
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PARASITIC_REGROWTH.descript:
Choose 1 of 3 random {IfUpgraded:show:Upgraded |}cards of the same color to add to your hand.
[gold]Slough[/gold]: It gains Replay 1 this turn.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PARASITIC_REGROWTH.selectio: Choose a card to add to your hand.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FALSE_HEALING.title: False Healing
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PUTRESCENT_GERMINATION.desc:
Exhaust 1 card in your hand.
Reduce {PutrescentGermination-Count:diff()} random debuffs on yourself by 1 each.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-REPRODUCIBILITY_CRISIS.desc: After you play a card with Replay, increase its Replay count and that of all your cards with the same name by 1.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ECDYSIS.title: Ecdysis
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ECDYSIS.variable.0: Whenever you remove a debuff, gain 1 [gold]Analysis[/gold] and 1 [gold]Strength[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ECDYSIS.variable.1: Whenever you remove a debuff, gain 1 [gold]Analysis[/gold] and 1 [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-METAPLASTIC_SKIN.title: Metaplastic Skin
HOOLHEYAKMOD-METAPLASTIC_SKIN.descriptio: Whenever you play a card, [gold]Slough[/gold]: Gain 1 [gold]Erudition[/gold] or [gold]Meander[/gold] based on its type.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-RENEWAL_RHYTHM.title: Renewal Rhythm
HOOLHEYAKMOD-RENEWAL_RHYTHM.description: Whenever you gain a new status instead of stacking one you already have, draw 1 card and gain 1 Energy.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-SLOUGH_EXHAUST.select_messa: Choose a card in your hand to exhaust.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FOR_THE_QUEST.title: In Search of Reason
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FOR_THE_QUEST.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply [gold]Lift[/gold] equal to half the target's [gold]Gravity[/gold] (rounded down).
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FORGETFULNESS.title: Forgetfulness
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FORGETFULNESS.description: At the start of your turn, choose 1 of 3 random cards to add to your hand. It is free to play this turn and is removed from this combat after being played.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-CROSS_SEARCH.selectionScree: Choose a card in your hand to discard.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DEEP_INQUIRY.title: Deeply Seek
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DEEP_INQUIRY.description: Choose an ally (you may choose yourself). Each ally chooses 1 of 3 random cards of that character's color to add to their own hand. It is free to play this turn.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DEEP_INQUIRY.selectionScree: Choose a card to add to your hand. It is free to play this turn.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DISTANT_LIGHT.title: Distant Light
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DISTANT_LIGHT.description: At the end of your turn, if the Attack damage you dealt this turn is less than 6, trigger Meander and Erudition.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DIFFICULTY_OPTION.title: Difficulty Option
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DIFF_NORMAL.title: Standard Evaluation
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DIFF_NORMAL.description:
Standard gameplay experience.
No special modifications.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DIFF_HARD.title: In-depth Analysis
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DIFF_HARD.description:
Challenging experience.
Erudition stack limit increased by *1.
Some card values or effects adjusted.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DIFF_EASY.title: Preliminary Investigation
HOOLHEYAKMOD-DIFF_EASY.description:
Difficulty suitable for familiarizing with mechanics.
Meander stack limit decreased by *1.
Some card values or effects adjusted.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PRESET_OPTION_CARD.title: Preset Option
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PRE_DEFAULT.title: Routine Investigation
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PRE_UNIVERSE.title: Just Borrowing
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PRE_UNIVERSE.description:
Make your deck *colorful!
Start with *Prismatic *Shard and *Cocktail *Shaker.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PRE_VARIABLE.title: Choices, Choices
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PRE_VARIABLE.description:
Fill your starting deck with *Experiment cards!
